sources.summary: The most hotly anticipated TV show of the year is here! And a number of the stars – ahem Grant Mitchell – are struggling already … Warning: this article contains spoilers for episode one of The Celebrity Traitors. So – have they managed to capture lightning in a franchised bottle again? The new series of The Celebrity Traitors, more hotly anticipated than Nigella entering the Bake Off tent, is here. Twenty-one contestants of varying levels of fame, but never dipping below C-list, have signed up to endure Claudia Winkleman’s tyranny in Ardross Castle, in the hope of winning up to £100,000 for their chosen charity and a place in the nation’s consciousness and possible heart for between one week and a lifetime, depending how things work out.
